title: Behind the Bottle: From Idea to Installation, See How our Creative Merchandise Displays Come to Life
summary: See how Coca-Cola Consolidated Teammates take creative merchandise displays from idea and design through building and installation.
body_markdown:
Go behind the bottle with Coca-Cola Consolidated Teammates in Ohio to see how creative merchandise displays come to life. Through a five-step process spanning idea, design, planning, building and installation, Teammates turn creative concepts into in-store experiences that surprise and delight customers. ⬇️
